name: Prediction Markets Daily
description: Prediction Markets Daily follows a field that changes every week. Every day: the rulings, rules and lawsuits deciding what prediction markets may be; the venues, their new products and the people building and criticizing them; a short board of the day's most traded questions with their prices, volumes and caveats; and one clear explainer on how these markets work and what the research says about them. It reports and explains — it never tells anyone what to trade. Not financial advice.
